mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPIAUCSL above 295 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL above 295 and rising.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE decline below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and accelerating Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST decline below 1400 and RSAFS decline below 680,000 million signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint HOUST/RSAFS decline fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), rising CPIAUCSL signals persistent inflation, triggering further rate hikes that compress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and rising CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in INDPRO signals manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate profit growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1400 thousand units signals housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise signals an extremely tight labor market, increasing wage inflation risks and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint UNRATE/PAYEMS signal fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 growth signals strong economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
